drafted_from: tools/close-a-list-row-when-i-say/records.json (tool:decide-what-a-said-done-answer-means) and src/said-done.mjs saidDoneVerdict; thresholds from src/said-done.json
start_here: Say to your AI: "Settle my row if I already said it is done, and hand it to my AIs if you are unsure." The workflow asks the classifier, then this tool says what the answer means.
no_lists_because: It settles nothing and keeps nothing: the workflow takes the settle values or the hand-off job it returns and calls the lists road and the hand-off tool, so no list of its own is kept.
instructions: 1. Give one ask from the name step, the classifier's probability (0 to 1, or null when no computer answered), and the message.
2. A verdict of done carries the settle values; take them to the lists road.
3. A verdict of unsure or no_classifier carries the hand-off job; take it to the person's AIs, once per message and row.
4. A verdict of not_said changes nothing.

worked_examples.title: A clear yes settles the row
worked_examples.ask: The classifier says 0.92 that the person says it is done.
worked_examples.given: The person says the plugin is done and the classifier is sure.
worked_examples.hands_back: A verdict "done" at probability 0.92, carrying the settle values with status "Done", to take to the lists road.
